agendas.name: Pursuit of Excellence
agendas.description: At battle end, the ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit with the lowest XP (select if tied) gains 1XP for each condition satisfied: not destroyed; within range of a controlled objective outside your deployment zone; destroyed 1+ enemy units; destroyed 3+ enemy units. Up to 4XP.

agendas.name: Judgement Delivered
agendas.description: At battle end, if no enemy models remain on the battlefield, each ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit still on the battlefield gains 2XP.

agendas.name: Great Tithe
agendas.description: Each time an enemy PSYKER unit is destroyed, if destroyed by an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit, that unit gains 2XP; otherwise, the closest ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit gains 1XP. Track tallies per unit.

agendas.name: Unto the Dark Cells
agendas.description: At battle end, if you control more objectives in No Man's Land than your opponent, select up to 3 ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within range of controlled No Man's Land objectives. Each selected unit gains 2XP.
